headline: US-Canada raid: 24 arrested in crackdown on India-based crime rings
summary: The 'Operation Hard Ball' investigation targeted three organized crime networks involved in contract killings, extortion, and drug trafficking across North America and Europe.
details: The United States has charged 37 people and arrested 24 following a long-term investigation across North America and Europe. The operation targeted three India-based organized crime rings involved in contract killings, kidnapping, extortion, and drug trafficking.

Among the accused are Lawrence Bishnoi, currently imprisoned in India, and Goldy Brar, who remains at large. US prosecutors allege that the two ordered the killing of Sikh separatist leader Hardeep Singh Nijjar in June 2023 in Surrey, British Columbia.

The investigation, dubbed 'Operation Hard Ball,' involved collaboration between US, Canadian, and international law enforcement agencies. Authorities executed 42 search warrants in Southern and Eastern California, seizing approximately 1,000 kg of cocaine, 1 kg of heroin, $40,000 USD, and a dozen firearms.

Another charge involves a drug trafficking ring led by Canadian citizen Ravinder Singh Dhanda, who allegedly used commercial trucks to smuggle hundreds of kilograms of cocaine and methamphetamine from the US to Canada.

Canadian officials described the operation as a major blow to transnational organized crime. Justice Minister Sean Fraser stated that this is a significant opportunity to reduce the cause of organized crime within Canadian communities.

Sikh organizations, including the World Sikh Organization of Canada and the Sikh Federation of Toronto, have welcomed the arrests but called for transparency regarding any potential involvement of foreign state agencies in these networks.

headline: Mbappe, Dembele fire France into World Cup semis with 2-0 win over Morocco
summary: Kylian Mbappe scored his 8th goal of the tournament, moving level with Lionel Messi for the Golden Boot race.
details: France secured a 2-0 victory over Morocco in their World Cup quarterfinal, advancing to the semi-finals. Kylian Mbappe opened the scoring with a brilliant curling finish in the 60th minute after having a first-half penalty saved.
Ousmane Dembele settled the contest in the 66th minute, curling a low shot into the net after a lay-off from Mbappe. The match was played before 63,811 spectators at the Gillette Stadium.

Mbappe's goal moved him level with Lionel Messi in the race for the Golden Boot, marking his 20th goal in 20 World Cup appearances. He is now just one goal behind Messi's overall tournament record of 21.

Morocco, despite having strong crowd support, lacked a cutting edge in attack, partly due to the absence of the injured Ismael Saibari. France maintained their third clean sheet in three knockout games.
France will now face either Spain or Belgium in the semi-finals in Dallas next Wednesday. The team is aiming for a third consecutive World Cup final appearance under coach Didier Deschamps.
The match featured key moments, including a missed penalty by Mbappe and a brilliant performance by Moroccan goalkeeper Yassine Bounou, who kept France at bay during the first half.
